error_policy.DeadlineRefusal: Future private control exception derives directly from BaseException; carries phase/until/observed-time strings. It bypasses unchanged capture(Exception) and same(OSError), while outer/caller top-level BaseException preservation paths still run.
error_policy.primary_refusal: First non-null reason is latched and never cleared. All later errors/cleanup outcomes append complete structured evidence.
error_policy.captured_error: capture result observed=null/error!=null is unavailable/error, never numeric0 or unchanged. Every consumer checks error before using observed. A deadline bypasses capture.
error_policy.same_false: False is MISMATCH_OR_READ_FAILURE, never observed unchanged; root/caller positive gates require True. DeadlineRefusal must not be an OSError and must propagate.
error_policy.sample_failure: Every actual RSS/member query/parser/cleanup error latches refusal. A contemporaneous valid NOTE_EXIT may label timing exit_race but never clear the error or substitute zero.
error_policy.unknown_status: PID/status/identity/receipt/time that is missing, partial or unobserved stays null with an explicit reason. No fallbacks to discovered groups or guessed completion.
error_policy.teardown: No acceptance relies on interpreter teardown. Strong references survive preservation; late/unknown/unreaped objects cause raw refusal. No new owned process API or wait is deliberately initiated after110.

ownership_invariants: Only the returned retained outer caller leader is the certified group anchor. No detached native session, preexec group change, discovery-based authority or competing wait.

Outer leader-only private Popen subclass overrides only __del__ with no-op; constructor otherwise unchanged. No leader poll/wait/communicate/send_signal/terminate/kill/context manager. This is an unimplemented source obligation, not proof of cleanup/containment.
Exact-PID waitpid is the sole deliberate leader reap. A consumed terminal pre-certificate status counts as that sole early reap; never assign returncode0 from absence or NOTE_EXIT data.
Set continuation_attempted=true before the SIGCONT syscall. Any uncertainty after that attempt requires certified-group cleanup; never fall back to assuming caller/native were not released.
Before certificate, or with certificate but no continuation attempt, abort may KILL only the known unreaped direct wrapper PID. Never CONT on an abort path.

After continuation attempt, outer alone may attempt certified-group TERM then at most one KILL before intentional leader reap. Signal attempt timestamp/state are stored before syscall, including failures.
Caller never signals native PID/group, owns no native stop timer/lock, and makes no native-group-absence claim. It may bounded-reap its own native direct child because it is not the group anchor.
Readonly ps queries may be cleaned only through their separately retained own direct PID; they confer no native/group signal authority.
After final signal decision and intentional leader reap, only one absence observation is allowed before110; never signal that numeric group again.
Unsupported native detachment or unknown constructor PID remains potential-cleanup/containment unknown and refusal. No broader opaque-native containment is claimed.

readonly_query_contract.allowed_dynamic_argument: Only the retained caller-owned native PID in NATIVE_IDENTITY. No arbitrary command/target path or group discovery.
readonly_query_contract.lifecycle: Narrow fixed query route only. Retain direct Popen query handle; nonblocking drain both streams and exact-PID WNOHANG status checks; decode actual terminal status with os.waitstatus_to_exitcode and assign once. No competing Popen poll/wait/context reap. A terminal status closes query signal authority forever. Timeout/read/error latches parent refusal; an outer query error initiates the parent group-TERM decision before query cleanup. If query remains unreaped, store its first own-PID KILL attempt and min(first-query-KILL+5s,shared110) reap deadline once. Never native/group signal from query cleanup. No new query work after110; unknown/late output remains partial/refused.

readonly_query_contract.time: until=min(query_start+2s,parent original phase deadline); all return/drain/status checks use that until for normal query acceptance. Failure cleanup uses existing shared110, not a fresh query allowance.
readonly_query_contract.streams: Complete stdout/stderr bytes retained in finite owned query files and count toward inclusive/growth caps; no truncation or deletion to hide overrun.
readonly_query_contract.normal_RSS_schedule: Immediately after CONT, then spacing>=0.5s with no catch-up; at most191 normal attempts before95. Query/parser failure stops normal work, not retry-to-success.
readonly_query_contract.final_member_snapshots: At most one normal-exit GROUP_ROWS snapshot before95, one post-TERM cleanup snapshot before stored TERM deadline, and one optional pre-reap KILL-phase diagnostic snapshot before110. Each has a distinct purpose; failure never becomes normal success.
readonly_query_contract.after_reap: No ps retry. One outer killpg(group,0) absence-only observation before110; only ESRCH means absent. Root's independent postreturn absence check remains separate and cannot erase owner refusal.

receipt_write_policy.normal: Encode full strict JSON, no truncation/row selection. Caller receipt <=33554432B validation ceiling derived from existing growth bound, not an added allowance. Write exclusive final pathname and hash complete bytes before summary within normal deadline.

receipt_write_policy.self_hash: No receipt embeds its own hash; separate terminal/outer/root metadata binds it.
receipt_write_policy.owner_final: Full closed-result write then postwrite stop/identity/size/growth/time checks. Keep their final acceptance/outer status in a separate root observation record, avoiding a self-rewriting receipt or self-predicted completion. Prefinal candidate fields cannot override outer nonzero or late/incomplete closure.
